# Playbook: publish-baseline
Use when: publish a baseline on the owner's order

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| name | the baseline name the owner gave | STOP. Say: "Which name for the new baseline?" |
| version | the new version the owner gave; never invent one | STOP. Say: "Which version for the new baseline?" |
| changeSetId | the change set or proposal id named | "none" |
| ownerOrder | the workspace owner's own words ordering it in this conversation, verbatim (no one else's "yes") | "none" |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Nothing was published: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Publishing needs an LPM API key."
2. CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: oldId = result.currentBaseline.id (empty if null); review = result.publicationGate.requiresFormalReview; matchedId = result.publicationGate.matchedApprovedChangeSetId (empty if null); materiality = result.publicationGate.materiality; orphans = result.requirementsAwaitingBaseline.count
   IF result.publicationGate.shouldBlockPublication == true and <saved:matchedId> is empty → STOP. Say: "Blocked (materiality <saved:materiality>, <result.publicationGate.reasonCodes>): the owner must approve a matching change set."
3. CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   Always make this call.
   IF an item has version == <input:version> → STOP. Say: "<input:version> already exists. Which new version?"
   IF <saved:oldId> is empty and result is not empty → STOP. Say: "No baseline is current: which one should be restored?"
   IF <saved:oldId> is empty → SAVE: csId = ""; mode = "live"; note = "first baseline"; go to step 8.
4. CALL `list_working_scope_delta_entities` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeType":"added","limitCount":100} [A]
   Always make this call.
   SAVE: delta = requirementId and changedAt of each item
5. CALL `list_working_scope_delta_entities` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeType":"changed","limitCount":100} [A]
   Always make this call.
   SAVE: delta = <saved:delta> plus requirementId and changedAt of each item
6. SAVE: csId = <input:changeSetId> if not "none", else <saved:matchedId>; mode = "live"; note = "no change set needed (materiality <saved:materiality>)"
   IF <saved:csId> is empty → go to step 8.
7. CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   SAVE: fp = result.scopeProposal.contentFingerprint (empty if absent); approvedAt = result.approvedAt; note = "change set <saved:csId>"
   IF result.status != "approved" → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <result.status>, not approved."
   IF <saved:fp> is not empty and (result.approvedContentFingerprint != <saved:fp> or <saved:orphans> > 0) → STOP. Say: "Proposal <saved:csId>: not approved in this form, or <saved:orphans> orphans."
   IF <saved:fp> is not empty → SAVE: mode = "proposal"; go to step 8.
   IF <saved:review> == true and <saved:csId> != <saved:matchedId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> no longer matches the scope: new change set, review again."
   IF <saved:review> == true and an item of <saved:delta> has no changedAt or one later than <saved:approvedAt> → STOP. Say: "<that requirementId> changed after <saved:csId> was approved: new change set, review again."
8. SAVE: notes = "Owner order: '<input:ownerOrder>'; <saved:note>"
   IF <saved:mode> == "proposal" → go to step 11.
9. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: publish baseline <input:name> <input:version> (<saved:note>)? (publish / do not)"
10. CALL `publish_baseline_from_working_scope` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","name":"<input:name>","version":"<input:version>","publicationNotes":"<saved:notes>"} [O] (no changeSetId, no isCurrent)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not confirmed: <error text>. Do not retry: rerun this playbook."
   SAVE: newId = result.baseline.id
   VERIFY: CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.currentBaseline.id != <saved:newId> or result.workingScope.addedCount != 0 or result.workingScope.changedCount != 0 → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> is not current with an empty delta."
   SAVE: added = 0; changed = 0; go to step 13.
11. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: publish approved proposal <saved:csId> as baseline <input:name> <input:version>? (publish / do not)"
12. CALL `publish_baseline_from_working_scope` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","name":"<input:name>","version":"<input:version>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>","expectedProposalFingerprint":"<saved:fp>","publicationNotes":"<saved:notes>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not published: <error text>. Do not retry."
   SAVE: newId = result.baseline.id
   VERIFY: CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.currentBaseline.id != <saved:newId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> is not the current baseline."
   SAVE: added = result.workingScope.addedCount; changed = result.workingScope.changedCount
13. CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A] (always, unless <saved:csId> is empty)
   SAVE: csAfter = result.status
   IF (<saved:review> == true or <saved:mode> == "proposal") and (<saved:csAfter> != "published" or result.publicationBaselineId != <saved:newId>) → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <saved:csAfter>, not published on <saved:newId>; never call publish_change_set."
14. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:newId>"} [A]
   SAVE: count = the number of items
15. CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF not exactly one item has isCurrent == true, or it is not <saved:newId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> is not the only current baseline."

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; baseline <input:name> <input:version>
Done: <baseline <saved:newId> published, current (was <saved:oldId>) | nothing published>; <change set <saved:csId> <saved:csAfter> | <saved:note>>
Evidence: owner order "<input:ownerOrder>"; re-read: current <saved:newId>, added <saved:added>, changed <saved:changed>; <saved:count> requirements | reads only
Pending: none | <the failed check> — <who must act>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | plan the new scope's work (lpm-plan-work) | none
```
change-set status: draft | in-review | approved | rejected | published, from step 13. Never claim a check that a step above did not run and pass.
